heading: Start NDT training any time of year
intro: Enrolment is open throughout the year. Courses are primarily self-paced, so you can join at any time and work through the learning material around your schedule.
items: Course starts run in the first week of each month, with enrolment also available at other times throughout the year.
Level III support is available throughout the year for course clarifications. Confirm the contact method and arrangements when you enrol.

Practicals are done in the Practical NDT simulator and in person at your employer’s facility, on its equipment and parts. Simulator practice supports training; it does not replace supervised experience, the practical examination or employer certification.
ctaLabel: Ask about enrolment and practical arrangements
